quantity: volume-equivalent diameter of the archived ADAM model
reference: DAMIT model 1804 calibrated size, Hanuš et al. (2017), A&A 601, A114
notes: DAMIT marks model 1804 as size-calibrated (D = 100 km, σ = 4 km), the volume-equivalent diameter of this ADAM solution. Hanuš et al. (2017) Table 4 lists 97 ± 4 km for the publication fit; the archived release is kept as archived. The fit used 27 light curves, 7 adaptive-optics images and 1 occultation (Table 3).
